How does the BFF Friendship Test app work?

The process is simple. You just need to enter yours and your friend's name in the BFF Friendship to start the friendship compatibility test. You then answer 10 simple questions about your friendship in this playful quiz. At the end of this fun little quiz you can see the friendship score in the buddy meter.


What is special about the BFF quiz? What kind of questions can expect here?

The friendship quiz tries to cover all aspects of this special BFF bond. The questions revolve around how much you know about your friends, how much you trust them and how does their presence in your life make you feel. Each question is designed carefully to help you gauge the closeness of this friendship bond and how compatible you are with this person. The questions help you realise if you already are at BFF level with this friend or if your friendship bond needs a little more work.


How many times I can take the quiz?

You can take the quiz as many times as you like. You can take the BFF quiz for each and every friend of yours. The app offers 4 sets of unique questions.
